intelBuild.title: How to build a gaming PC
intelBuild.scope: Component roles and assembly planning. Used to ground the complete-system checklist, not to endorse Intel hardware or calculate a DIY savings percentage.
intelBuild.limitations: Manufacturer guidance is not a neutral benchmark, retailer quote or universal claim that DIY is cheaper.
intelBuild.rights: Citation and limited factual paraphrase only.

windowsActivation.title: Reactivating Windows after a hardware change
windowsActivation.scope: A significant hardware change such as replacing the motherboard can require reactivation. Matching Windows edition and the actual licence matter.
windowsActivation.limitations: Account linking does not by itself establish transfer rights. No legal licence interpretation, key reseller endorsement or assumed free Windows cost.
windowsActivation.rights: Citation and limited factual paraphrase only.

msi-5070.title: GeForce RTX 5070 12G VENTUS 3X OC datasheet
msi-5070.scope: G5070-12V3C; dimensions 302 × 121 × 49 mm, 16-pin connection and output ports.
msi-5070.limitations: Dimensions are manufacturer specifications, not a site measurement or proof of complete case clearance.
msi-5070.rights: Citation and original paraphrase; no copied images, benchmark tables or datasets.

asus-5070.title: PRIME-RTX5070-O12G technical specifications
asus-5070.scope: Exact OC model; dimensions 304 × 126 × 50 mm and 2.5-slot designation.
asus-5070.limitations: Do not apply this model’s dimensions to white, non-OC, Ti or other partner variants.
asus-5070.rights: Citation and original paraphrase; no copied images, benchmark tables or datasets.

north-sheet.title: Original North English product sheet
north-sheet.scope: Original North case: 355 mm GPU allowance with front fan; 300 mm with front 360 mm radiator.
north-sheet.limitations: Exclude North XL and other editions; this is a conditional length check, not full fit certification.
north-sheet.rights: Citation and original paraphrase; no copied images, benchmark tables or datasets.

amd-9800x3d-cooling.title: Ryzen 7 9800X3D desktop processor specifications
amd-9800x3d-cooling.scope: Exact boxed part 100-100001084WOF has no included thermal solution; AMD recommends liquid cooling for optimal performance.
amd-9800x3d-cooling.limitations: A manufacturer recommendation is not a measured result for every cooler, a requirement for a particular radiator size or proof of thermal adequacy.
amd-9800x3d-cooling.rights: Source citation and original factual explanation; no copied photographs, diagrams or benchmark datasets.

noctua-g2-specs.title: NH-D15 G2 specifications
noctua-g2-specs.scope: Standard NH-D15 G2: 168 mm published height with and without fans; supplied mounting system and thermal compound.
noctua-g2-specs.limitations: Do not substitute NH-D15, HBC, LBC or a different mounting revision. Listed socket support does not certify the complete installed layout.
noctua-g2-specs.rights: Source citation and original factual explanation; no copied photographs, diagrams or benchmark datasets.

noctua-ram.title: CPU cooler RAM clearance
noctua-ram.scope: NH-D15 G2 standard dual-fan RAM clearance is 32 mm; raising an overhanging front fan increases the required case clearance.
noctua-ram.limitations: The worked arithmetic here uses that documented configuration. It is not a universal formula for all coolers or a measurement of the reader’s case.
noctua-ram.rights: Source citation and original factual explanation; no copied photographs, diagrams or benchmark datasets.

arctic-lf3-manual.title: Liquid Freezer III 360 installation manual
arctic-lf3-manual.scope: Exact cooler socket-specific mounting paths, motherboard compatibility link, all-in-one or individual PWM wiring and radiator installation guidance.
arctic-lf3-manual.limitations: Do not transfer instructions to Liquid Freezer III Pro, another size or another revision. The exact motherboard manual still governs header ratings and controls.
arctic-lf3-manual.rights: Source citation and original factual explanation; no copied photographs, diagrams or benchmark datasets.

arctic-lf3-drawing.title: Liquid Freezer III 360 two-dimensional drawing
arctic-lf3-drawing.scope: ACFRE00136A drawing labels radiator thickness 38 mm and radiator/fan assembly envelope 66 mm. Drawing revision January 31, 2024.
arctic-lf3-drawing.limitations: An occupied envelope is more useful than a nominal radiator class. Drawing length and a separate specification sheet differ; no disputed length is used to certify fit.
arctic-lf3-drawing.rights: Source citation and original factual explanation; no copied photographs, diagrams or benchmark datasets.

north-radiator.title: Original North radiator compatibility
north-radiator.scope: Original North: top radiator width limit 122 mm, front width limit 151 mm and conditional 35 mm motherboard-component height for a top radiator.
north-radiator.limitations: Not North XL, North XL RC or every radiator stack. These conditional dimensions do not prove complete compatibility of a named cooler.
north-radiator.rights: Source citation and original factual explanation; no copied photographs, diagrams or benchmark datasets.

msi-cooler-guide.title: How to choose a CPU cooler
msi-cooler-guide.scope: Manufacturer explanation separating socket mounting, case height, RAM clearance, radiator fit and workload-related thermal needs.
msi-cooler-guide.limitations: Published September 23, 2026. Manufacturer marketing recommendations and generic radiator-thickness ranges are not adopted as universal limits or benchmark results.
msi-cooler-guide.rights: Source citation and original factual explanation; no copied photographs, diagrams or benchmark datasets.
